question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a white ball, Bob has a brown ball, Claire has a purple ball, Dave has a silver ball, Eve has a red ball, Fred has a teal ball, and Gertrude has a gold ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Fred and Alice swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Fred swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Claire swap balls. Then, Dave and Claire swap balls. Then, Eve and Bob swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Eve swap balls. Finally, Gertrude and Dave swap balls. At the end of the game, Bob has the
Options:
(A) white ball
(B) brown ball
(C) purple ball
(D) silver ball
(E) red ball
(F) teal ball
(G) gold ball
solution:
Each row lists the ball colors held by Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude, in that order.
Initial: white, brown, purple, silver, red, teal, gold
1. Fred ↔ Alice: teal, brown, purple, silver, red, white, gold
2. Gertrude ↔ Fred: teal, brown, purple, silver, red, gold, white
3. Gertrude ↔ Claire: teal, brown, white, silver, red, gold, purple
4. Dave ↔ Claire: teal, brown, silver, white, red, gold, purple
5. Eve ↔ Bob: teal, red, silver, white, brown, gold, purple
6. Gertrude ↔ Eve: teal, red, silver, white, purple, gold, brown
7. Gertrude ↔ Dave: teal, red, silver, brown, purple, gold, white
Bob has the red ball, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
